verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents scheduling of feature-flag rules ("scope, ramp, and schedule them"), and its Enterprise tier lists "Ramp schedules". This gives time-based automation of rollout steps, but none of it shows general recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: recurring/cron-style job scheduling, scheduling of arbitrary workflows (e.g. via API or MCP), detailed docs on schedule behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
